response.sql: WITH event_ratios AS (SELECT link_to_event AS event_id, 1.0 * SUM(spent) / NULLIF(SUM(amount), 0) AS spend_ratio FROM budget GROUP BY link_to_event), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(spend_ratio) AS avg_spend_ratio FROM event_ratios) SELECT er.event_id, er.spend_ratio, er.spend_ratio / NULLIF(ar.avg_spend_ratio, 0) AS relative_ratio FROM event_ratios AS er CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS ar ORDER BY relative_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
